claim: The modular, functional-fermion, response-root, weak/Higgs and complex-flavour Pfaffian objects share partial transformation data but are line objects over different bases; no identification is valid without an explicit base map and equivariant fibre intertwiner.

lines.name: genus_two_modular
lines.base: genus-two spin curves or period matrices

lines.name: majorana_functional
lines.base: metrics, spin structures and background fields

lines.name: response_root
lines.base: nondegenerate real response roots over H2(R)+

lines.name: weak_higgs
lines.base: weak alternating bilinears and field configurations

lines.name: complex_flavour_majorana
lines.base: complex symmetric mass matrices modulo rephasing

candidateEdges.gate: derive the full genus-two Majorana-Baby-Monster determinant multiplier
derive response coordinates from the CFT and map the separating divisor to det(Psi)=0
derive the microscopic Furey/Higgs pullback of the alternating form
supply a compatible physical real structure through complex flavour phase space

establishedNonIdentifications: A central minus identity on a two-frame preserves its determinant and is not a response-Pfaffian sheet flip.
An additive bosonization sum is not the multiplicative chi5 determinant line.
A complex flavour determinant has no canonical real sign without extra structure.
Equality of abstract Z2 characters does not identify line bundles over different bases.
